trackerLog.subject: Asteria

set.notes: User accepted 2.5D plates+sprites as the presentation lock. User accepted length 22 / 36 / 78. Stacked score and FEAT-006 ATB unchanged from the SET-0.1 path discussion.

feature.title: Presentation: 2.5D plates and sprites
feature.notes: Target look is painted or pre-rendered scene plates plus 2D walk/battle sprites plus portrait busts. 3/4 field, side-or-3/4 battle stage. Not realtime 3D. Pixel-pure 2D is a fallback slice only. SET-0.1 style mix still holds: FF9 tone, FF8 proportions, FF7 industry contrast as material language.

feature.title: Length targets 22 / 36 / 78
feature.notes: Story only 22 hours (Acts 0-7 plus 12-13, skip open-world extras). 70 percent 36 hours. 100 percent 78 hours (personals that still exist after FEAT-038, six temple rebounds, remnants, song-duel and brass-card finales). Hours move if main-side die.

trackerLog.decision: 2.5D plates+sprites is the presentation lock. User preferred.
